notes: Scope: Home vertical only (nykaafashion.com/home/c/8528), a fashion/beauty marketplace-retailer's Home department. Access: direct HTTP (curl_cffi) works for homepage/robots.txt/sitemap but Akamai WAF returns 403 on every /c/<id> listing page tried; Playwright/CDP is blocked at the connection level (consistent net::ERR_HTTP2_PROTOCOL_ERROR on every URL incl. the plain homepage, 2 attempts, 2 launch configs) - Akamai detecting the CDP/automation fingerprint. robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow (generic User-agent: * with only /ndsxadm/, /catalogsearch/, /widget-listing/, /all-reviews, /gateway-api/, /rest/appapi/V2/ blocked), so escalated to Claude-in-Chrome (tier 3) for all page verification once tier 1/2 were exhausted. Checked: (1) full desktop+mobile mega-menu JSON embedded in homepage SSR HTML (__PRELOADED_STATE__-style category tree under parent_id:2), enumerating every top-level tab (What's New, Sale, Home, Sports & Fitness, etc.) and their Home-scoped children_data; (2) the site's category sitemap (sitemap-v2/sitemap-categories-1.xml, 5573 URLs) grepped for bestseller/best-seller/top-seller/popular/trending/customer-favourite - zero hits anywhere on the whole site, not just Home; (3) opened /home/c/8528 (the main Home department PLP) directly via Claude-in-Chrome - default sort is 'Popularity' and several individual products carry a per-listing 'BESTSELLER' badge, but this is the ordinary Home category listing (102,471 items total), not a dedicated Bestsellers concept - per brief rule, a badge on individual products does not make the page a Bestsellers PLP; (4) site's own catalogsearch is Disallow'd in robots.txt so it was not used to probe for a hidden Bestsellers landing page. No nav tab, sitemap URL, or on-page signal anywhere in the Home vertical (or sitewide) names a dedicated Bestsellers/Top Sellers/Most Popular/Customer Favorites listing - 'sort=popularity' and 'BESTSELLER' are product-level signals only, never a standalone merchandising PLP. Genuine absence confirmed after full navigation + sitemap check; not a default/empty-search false negative.
